definitions.explanation: The player with the highest batting average in a league or season. An important statistical title in professional baseball.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who this year's batting champion will be.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: He won the batting title for three consecutive years.

examples.japanese: {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離|はな}せなかった→離す：19372_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: The batting title race continued until the final stretch, and you couldn't take your eyes off the last game.

notes:
Combines ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧ (first place, top position) and ⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧ (batter, hitter). A prestigious individual title in Japanese professional baseball (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦プロ{野球|やきゅう}→プロ野球：08837_puroyakyuu⟧), awarded to the player with the highest batting average who meets the minimum plate appearance requirement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: batting title race
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to win the batting title
